detailedImplementation:
## Prerequisites

• **Splunk** ≥9.2 or Splunk Cloud.
• **Regulatory mapping**: This detection evidences NO KBF `§6-8` (Sikkerhetskopier).
• **Lookups**: Deploy and version all KBF registers referenced in the SPL.

## Step 1 — Data collection

(1) Ingest Veeam/Rubrik/Commvault via Splunkbase TAs. (2) Join host to `kraftsensitiv_asset_register.csv`. (3) Alert on failure and restore-test staleness separately.

## Step 2 — Implement the search

```spl
index=backup sourcetype IN ("veeam:job","rubrik:backup","commvault:job") earliest=-7d
| lookup kraftsensitiv_asset_register.csv host OUTPUT classification
| where classification="kraftsensitiv"
| stats latest(job_status) as status latest(restore_test_date) as restore_test by host, job_name
| eval restore_age=round((now()-strptime(restore_test,"%Y-%m-%d"))/86400,1)
| where status!="Success" OR restore_age>180 OR isnull(restore_test)
| sort - restore_age
```

## Step 3 — Validate

Run positive/negative control tests per `controlTest` block.

## Step 4 — Evidence archive

Route results to `index=audit_evidence` with `reg=NO_KBF,uc=22.26.28,clause=§6-8` markers.
